description: Is this email real or fake? Paste the raw headers of an email (Gmail Show original, Outlook View message details). Returns who really sent it (From, Reply-To, Return-Path), the SPF/DKIM/DMARC results recorded by the receiving provider, look-alike or fake sender names (banks, SARS, couriers, free-mail accounts posing as companies), every Received hop with delays, the sending server IP with country/network, and a verdict: verified, unverified or suspicious. Nothing is stored.
name: analyze_email_headers
